d.ko: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?
d.en: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?
d.zh: 扮演海关关员，体验融入Roguelike元素的机场安检模拟。每只行李箱都可能暗藏猫腻。查验证件、盘问旅客、扫描行李、查扣违禁品，守好卡尔多拉机场的关口。秉公执法，还是放水捞钱？由你决定。
